checks: Native projection binds all six named parameters across T1..T5 (HP bonus 6/25,7/25,8/25,9/25,2/5; lowest-hp heal and shield ratios 1/5,1/4,3/10,7/20,2/5; team heal 1/10,1/8,3/20,7/40,1/5; 15s shield duration; 30s ICD) with exact frozen fractions and bIsPercent unit hints pinned, rejects group mismatches (character:1004 group vs weapon group ONE), flipped unit hints on both the HP and random-effect curves, and foreign weapons; random-effect curves are name-bound, not DataList-position bound (mutating only the HP curve leaves them unchanged).

Seeded PCG32 draws under the fixed per-slot selector 2^62+slot are hand-derived, not copied from code: seed4 -> word 2057372262 (mod 3 = 0) -> outcome0, seed0 -> word 3837872008 (mod 3 = 1) -> outcome1, seed2 -> word 257813417 (mod 3 = 2) -> outcome2. Raw draws and final states reconcile, the full report is byte-identical across replays, crit RNG stays independent, and colliding selectors are rejected. Three distinct seeds producing three outcomes exercises the unbiased bounded-selection mechanism; it does not prove equal native probabilities (hypothesis, see tested_hypotheses).

At 1000 Max HP, T1 shield capacity is exactly 200 (1000*1/5) expiring at 15_000_000 us. Damage at 14_999_999 is absorbed 100 with zero HP loss; damage at the exact 15_000_000 deadline bypasses the shield (half-open lifetime). Shields persist through actor switching, replace the proc's own prior shield key, and clear on wearer death.

Healing zone math: base 200 with outgoing 1/5 and incoming 1/10 settles to 200*(6/5)*(11/10)=264 exactly (nearest integer). Caps: 990+264->1000 with overflow 254, 1000+264->1000 with overflow 264, defeated recipients never revive. Lowest-HP selection uses exact hp/max fractions with first-slot ties kept.

Live Max HP capture: Suit10 incoming100 raises admission Max HP 1000->1040; the same Ultimate then captures shield 1040*1/5=208 or team heal 1040*1/10=104. Suit10 subsequently caps at 1400 Max HP before callbacks; healing 900->1004 then damage 1 ->1003 stays valid above the static 1000. Later damage runs against the live Max HP.

Successful admission consumes the 30s ICD even at full HP; before-deadline casts and failed admissions draw nothing. Exact 30s deadline is ready; separate wearers keep independent streams and deadlines with chronological receipts. Owner defeat before the callback cancels settlement (nakupeda_cancelled) while retaining the audited selection and ICD provenance.

Shield settlement sums static and live granter shield_bonus in one outgoing zone with a single final rounding: base 200 with static 0.2 and live 0.3 settles to 300; fractional base 1003/4 with the same bonuses settles once to 376 (376.125 nearest). The settled shield survives live-modifier expiry at its fixed capacity and absorbs incoming damage before HP. Conservation: incoming 800 against 500 HP with a 200 shield absorbs 200, loses 500 HP, overkills 100.

Runtime: selection is dispatched by the real gear on-cast hook (crates/content/src/gear.rs on_cast -> weapons::nakupeda::on_cast) on Ultimate casts; settlement runs through the real callback dispatch (crates/content/src/callbacks.rs NakupedaProc -> weapons::nakupeda::apply) with same-timestamp ProcCallback priority. Projection reports runtime_execution_validated=true. Absorption is exercised only through the explicit incoming-damage fixture (combat.incoming_damage_fixture_v1), which models neither enemy AI nor mitigation.
Focused run: 19/19 nakupeda tests pass. No full suite per the 4-CPU budget; rust_quality pre-existing warnings untouched; no rustfmt run (check-mode tools only).

The heal uses the recipient's Max HP times the tier ratio; the shield uses the captured exact wearer Max HP times its ratio, multiplied at the grant callback by one plus the granter's static and live shield_bonus summed in the outgoing shield zone (COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT sections 1 and 5), then rounded once to nearest integer. Seeded per-slot PCG32 selection, 30s world-time ICD from admission, Max-HP capture at admission, and same-timestamp callback settlement are explicit reviewed hypotheses, not verified native caller behavior.

known_gaps: Global release availability is unverified in the frozen catalog.

Native caller evidence does not establish the three branch probabilities: the seeded selection executes an unbiased bounded PCG32 draw in the harness, but equal probability is a reviewed hypothesis, not a verified native fact (return condition: verify against native caller/branch evidence).

Native caller evidence does not establish recipient Max HP scaling for healing (ratio units and the 'of Max HP' wording support it but do not prove native caller scaling), shield recipient identity (inferred from the wearer wording), same-time callback ordering, or lifetime policies. These explicit hypotheses remain in reports and require acceptance in strict mode.

Incoming damage is an explicit settled fixture (combat.incoming_damage_fixture_v1), not enemy AI or mitigation. Native HP/DEF quantization (Q1-V7) is unresolved: the nearest-integer settlement rounding is the exact-path convention, not a verified native rule. Other shield-producing/strengthening effects retain their owning gaps.

Adler Blessing and Nacupeda consume the shared static/live granter shield_bonus through the same outgoing zone; yuren (Rainman) grant-time self bonus is additionally composed. Other native shield producers and their bonuses retain their owning gaps.
name: Nacupeda

passive_description.localized:
Increases HP by <lv>{0}</>.
Grants one of the following random effects when the wearer casts an Ultimate:
1. Recovers <lv>{1}</> of Max HP for the team member with the lowest HP percentage.
2. Grants a Shield equal to <lv>{2}</> of the wearer's Max HP for <lv>{3}</>s.
3. Recovers <lv>{4}</> HP for all team members.
Triggers once every <lv>{5}</>s.
passive_description.source:
生命值提高<lv>{0}</>。
装备者释放「极轨终结」时，获得以下随机一个效果：
1.使队伍中血量百分比最低的角色回复其<lv>{1}</>最大生命值。
2.获得一个装备者<lv>{2}</>最大生命值的护盾,持续<lv>{3}</>秒。
3.使全队角色回复<lv>{4}</>生命值。
该效果每<lv>{5}</>秒最多触发一次。

tested_hypotheses: Effect1 and effect3 heal by recipient Max HP times the tier ratio; effect2 shields the wearer by captured exact wearer Max HP times its ratio. Ratio units and the native 'of Max HP' wording support this bounded choice but do not prove native caller scaling.

The three-way choice is an unbiased bounded PCG32 draw under the fixed per-slot selector, separately audited from crit RNG; EQUAL PROBABILITY IS A HYPOTHESIS. Three distinct seeds producing three distinct outcomes exercises the selection mechanism; native branch probabilities are unverified and require native caller/branch evidence to promote.

Recipients and effective Max HP are captured at admission before same-time cast buff callbacks; the same-timestamp ProcCallback then applies live source/recipient healing bonuses and the outgoing shield-bonus sum with one nearest-integer conversion, caps, no revival, and owner-defeat cancellation of settlement.
The 30s world-time ICD starts on successful admission including full-HP casts; the exact 30s deadline is ready. Defeated owners cancel callback settlement without undoing selection or ICD provenance.

Shield base uses the captured exact wearer Max HP ratio. At the grant callback, static and live granter shield_bonus are summed in one outgoing zone and the product is rounded once; later modifier expiry does not rescale capacity. The settled shield replaces the same owner key, absorbs before HP with oldest-first shared settlement, expires at the half-open 15s deadline, persists through switching, and is removed on wearer death.

runtime_execution_validated=true holds with this precise scope: selection via the real gear on-cast dispatch and settlement via the real callback dispatch are executed through run_game_scenario paths; absorption is exercised only through the explicit incoming-damage fixture. Native caller behavior, branch probabilities, same-time ordering and native rounding remain hypotheses.

There is no exclusive character in frozen data: ExclusiveCharacterIDArray is empty and ExclusiveDesc has no string, so wearer legality follows ApplyGroupType ONE plus the weapon-id binding; cross-group wearers and foreign weapons are rejected.
